NOW LIVE !!! Ahn'Qiraj Ruins no longer drops set items, instead the instance now has tier tokens assigned to each boss. Kurinaxx + Rajaxx drops Cloak Token(s), Buru + Ayamiss drops Ring Token(s), Moam + Ossirian drops Neck Token(s). Once exchanging these tokens for the set piece (done in the tier 2.5 exchange option from Major Mattingly or Overlord Run'thak), you will unlock the option to buy additional tokens.

3.description: Implemented localization functionality to Ascension Website and Launcher. Going forwards we will be working on getting both the website and launcher available in relevant languages to our player population. The first iteration released now allows both the website and launcher to be used in English (enUS) or in Mandarin (zhCN). Several other languages are currently in the process of translation and will soon follow.
